title: Lakeflow Designer October release
body:
The Lakeflow Designer October release adds new AI Function and Prepare capabilities, an HTML operator, shareable full-screen previews, and tools for organizing large flows. The following updates are now available:

* **Find operators by category**: The **Operators** pane groups operators into input and output, clean, combine, transform, code, report, and canvas tools. See [Built-in operators in Lakeflow Designer](/aws/en/designer/built-in-operators).
* **Use `ai_decide` in the AI Function operator (Beta)**: Answer questions about text or parsed documents with probabilities, choices, or scores. See [`ai_decide` function](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ai_decide).
* **Publish a custom operator to your workspace**: In the operator panel, open a custom operator's actions menu and select **Publish**. The file switches to the published copy so you can reuse the operator in other visual data prep files. See [Custom operators in Lakeflow Designer](/aws/en/designer/user-operators). \_Note: user-defined operators are now called custom operators. See \_[Custom operators](/aws/en/designer/user-operators).
* **Auto layout a group**: Use **Auto layout group** in the group toolbar to arrange only the operators inside that group and leave the rest of the canvas unchanged. See [Group](/aws/en/designer/built-in-operators#group).
* **Parameter usage in the Parameters panel**: The Parameters side panel now shows which operators use each parameter. Select an operator name to focus it on the canvas. See [Parameters](/aws/en/designer/parameters).
* **Favorite operators**: Right-click an operator or click  in the table of contents to add it to your favorites. To show only favorites, select **Filter by** > **Status** > **Favorited** in the table of contents. See [Use the table of contents in Lakeflow Designer](/aws/en/designer/table-of-contents).
* **HTML operator**: Render a custom HTML page, including embedded CSS and JavaScript, in the output pane. Connect upstream operators to display their data as charts, tables, or other views. See [HTML](/aws/en/designer/built-in-operators#html).
* **Share full-screen previews**: Open a Visualization or HTML output in full screen and share the page URL. Users who open the link land on the canvas with that operator's output in full screen. See [Use the output pane](/aws/en/designer/preview-results#output-pane).
* **Install custom operator dependencies**: When you add a custom operator with missing dependencies, select **Add dependencies**, then **Apply** in the **Environment** pane to install them. See [Custom operators in Lakeflow Designer](/aws/en/designer/user-operators).
* **Sort operators by modification time**: Select **Modified** in the table of contents **Sort by** menu to order operators by when they were last changed. See [Sort and filter the list](/aws/en/designer/table-of-contents#sort-filter).
* **Control runs from the file menu**: Click  in the file header and select **Run** to access **Run all**, **Interrupt execution**, clearing actions, and **Go to last run operator**.
* **Reference operators in Genie Code**: Type `@` and select a canvas operator from **Operators** to give your prompt context about that part of the flow. See [Prompt Genie Code on the canvas](/aws/en/designer/genie-code#canvas-prompt).
* **Connect files using your own account**: In a Source operator, select **My Google account** or **My Microsoft account** to connect to Google Drive, SharePoint, or OneDrive files. Sign in and provide the file link. The corresponding connector must be enabled.
* **Save intermediate results with checkpoints**: In **Operator settings**, set **Checkpoint** to **On** to save an operator's results for reuse during previews, or use **Auto** to let Designer choose which results to save. Saved results are reused within the same compute session.
* **Organize groups and notes**: Use the group hover toolbar to collapse or disable a group, and choose colors for groups and notes. Press **Shift+2** to zoom to selected operators.
* **New Prepare actions**: Use **Parse JSON** to expand JSON data, **Rename columns** to rename multiple columns with one rule, and **Multi column formula** to apply one expression to selected columns. Existing actions such as **Change type** and **Trim** also accept multiple columns. See [Prepare](/aws/en/designer/built-in-operators#prepare).
* **Run up to an operator**: Right-click an operator and select **Run up to this operator** to run it and its upstream operators against the full dataset. Downstream operators and disconnected branches do not run.
* **Reset preview overrides**: Select **Apply to all operators** in the **Preview** menu to clear individual **Rows scanned** overrides and use the file's current default. See [Preview results](/aws/en/designer/preview-results#preview).
* **Improved legibility for large workflows**: Operators retain their size and shape and display a new larger operator icon when you zoom out on the canvas.
